paths: proposed paths only; parent must create source copies and freeze their initial manifests
existing_wrapper_forces: MANIFOLD_PAR/TEST/CBIND/PYBIND/DEBUG OFF and scoped BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF
existing_protections: preserve no-server, validated local package/cache, FETCHCONTENT_FULLY_DISCONNECTED ON; do not replace with unprotected command
numeric_options: leave CLIPPER2_HI_PRECISION OFF and CLIPPER2_MAX_DECIMAL_PRECISION 8 defaults unchanged
additional_case_alias: exact mixed-case variable only satisfies upstream logmissingdep guard; uppercase remains actual provider/source override
cpp_source_subdir: CPP supplied by wrapper declaration; source path must be Clipper root, not /CPP
